args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after deploying v2.3.1 to production (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions. Rollback verified: all regions now on v2.3.0. Investigating root cause of v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the latest production release and was unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified — all three regions are now on v2.3.0.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback, which paged the on-call engineer for follow-up on root cause.

Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy, but it was a staging release, so it wasn't part of the production rollback.
